facts: Vans Premium Authentic low-top lace-up sneaker, adult women's size, about 25 cm long
upper: black and off-white checkerboard; ONLY the black squares are covered in raised black sequins (a few loose, raised at the edges); the off-white squares are plain woven canvas
black leather binding round the collar with white stitching; black tongue; natural tan canvas lining inside the collar
flat black cotton laces through four pairs of black metal eyelets
small BLACK woven tab on the outer side near the laces with white 'VANS' letters and a small (R), sewn flat
back: a vertical BLACK canvas heel stripe with white stitching down the middle of the heel
chunky smooth off-white rubber sidewall, slightly taller at the toe; on the back of the sidewall a small WHITE 'OFF THE WALL' skateboard label with black print
insole: deep RED with a WHITE rectangle holding the red VANS skateboard-tail logo
Grace's own video (ref/grace_ref.mp4) shows the same shoe on her feet and in her hand
